answer_summary: Using the derived part 4.4 energy of 185.20 MeV per fission, the exact raw results are TN = 4.230206366232801957e24 fissions and m = 5.558991132160095 kg of 90%-enriched uranium; to three significant figures, TN = 4.23e24 and m = 5.56 kg.
assumptions: The question's requested energy balance identifies the 30-kiloton TNT-equivalent energy with the energy released by the counted fissions.
The exact SI values 1 MeV = 1.602176634e-13 J and N_A = 6.02214076e23 mol^-1 are used as trusted general laws.
Rubidium has atomic number 37 and caesium atomic number 55; both are periodic-table group 1 elements.
The printed uranium-235 atomic mass 235.04 is used as the numerical molar mass 235.04 g mol^-1.
Per TASK.json, stipulated printed numbers are treated as exact and rounding occurs only at the final three-significant-figure boundary.
